title_en: Wonders of Chinese Engineering (15/20): The Sichuan–Tibet Railway
note_en: 将 (jiāng) before a verb marks a future event in formal, written Chinese: 川藏铁路建成后，将大大缩短四川和西藏之间的交通时间 "once the Sichuan–Tibet Railway is finished, it will greatly cut travel time between Sichuan and Tibet." It does the job of English "will," like 会 in speech, but sounds like news reports and official plans; the text uses it again in 旅行时间将从…缩短到… and 将与已有的川藏公路共同构成….
